objective: RTX4070_SelfEvolving_Jev_Research_Proposal.md -- harness-first, ecosystem-aligned. The project runs agent-jev's scripts/autoresearch_agent.py; it does not run its own orchestrator.

groups.superseded_controller: pipeline/ and loop/ -- the orchestrator written before the decision to drive the ecosystem loop, plus measurement/run_pipeline.py which imported it. Quarantined by the operator's explicit instruction. The harness modules inside pipeline/ (isotonic, non-monotone window, Stage) are NOT duplicated in the archive as dead code -- they remain the reference for what a harness route must do, and head_route.py's feature handling is the only place they were used.
groups.laya_artifacts: measurement/q1_dev_*.json -- per-type accuracy keyed on `noul`, a question type that exists only in the laya rendering. Neither file mentioned laya by name, which is why the name-based purity pattern passed them; the guard now also matches the artefact vocabulary.
groups.confirmed_junk: ghorg.json (a GitHub API 404 response body), race.gif, and a script already marked .broken_ in its filename.

method: git mv, so the archive is tracked and survives `git checkout -- .`. An earlier attempt used shutil.move and was silently undone by a checkout issued to repair a different problem; tracked moves do not have that failure mode.

not_quarantined.lean/: operator decision -- Lean 4 formalisation of the accept rule, which is Rule 1's object
not_quarantined.harness/: still the reference implementation of the calibration stages
not_quarantined.docs/prereg_floor_b_lora_2026-09-29.md: the pre-registration that forbids inheriting the laya Floor B; deleting the warning is how the threshold gets re-inherited
